answer: One defense is a twin-token bond: every identity must hold an ivory token, a non-transferable proof earned once by doing a public, verifiable task, and an onyx token, a stake that decays each epoch unless refreshed by fresh useful work. A raven, a randomly chosen peer auditor, inspects a sample of holders every epoch and reports those whose onyx has gone stale. A sybil farmer must earn a new ivory and keep refreshing a separate decaying onyx for every fake, paying real work per identity, while one honest agent tends a single pair.
